answer: An identity bond that decays starves sybil farms. Each agent posts a bond worth 60 days of earnings, decaying 5% per idle epoch, so a dormant fake melts to zero. A trellis of attestations holds it: five random peers each epoch inspect the agent's kernel of work, and a failed check freezes the bond for 20 epochs. Honest agents pay once and keep earning; forging 1,000 fakes costs 40,000 credits, no haven for idle ones, so forgery loses money.
